cat > finish.py <<'PY'
import arena, subprocess, os,sys
for i in range(int(sys.argv[1])):
 b=arena.load_board()
 if arena.result(b):print('RESULT',arena.result(b));break
 out=subprocess.check_output(['python3','analyze.py','30'],env=dict(os.environ,ROUNDS='2'),text=True)
 lines=out.strip().splitlines(); print('\n'.join(lines[-2:]),flush=True)
 m=lines[-1].split()[1]
 b.push_uci(m)
 if b.is_repetition(3): print('REFUSE REPETITION');break
 b=arena._request('move '+m)
 print('Played',m,'reply',b.peek(),'FEN',b.fen(),'RESULT',arena.result(b),flush=True)
